title: Chicago Mayoral Candidate Lisa Nee on Affordable Housing, Fiscal Responsibility and Public Safety

statements.summary: Supports expediting the permit process for housing development to prevent losing developers to other cities.
statements.quote: The permit process needs to be expedited. There’s a lot of waste in there and I’ve spoken to people who wanted to build housing and said, ‘It took too long and I decided to go somewhere else.’ We can’t be losing those people to other cities that are growing while we are not growing.

statements.summary: Proposes utilizing vacant properties to increase housing supply.
statements.quote: I think there’s about 120,000 vacant places that we can start expediting. And how do we get that up to speed and fill those?
